label: Bible Study
prompt: But when thou doest alms, let not thy _____ hand know what thy right hand doeth:
verse: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
note: Giving in secret — so quietly that even your other hand doesn't hear about it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For a small _____ have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
verse: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
note: Forsaken for a small moment, gathered with great mercies — the sorrow is short, the mercy is great.

label: Sunday School
prompt: The elder unto the elect _____ and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
verse: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
note: John addresses this little letter to 'the elect lady and her children' — perhaps a woman, perhaps a whole church.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the _____ was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.
verse: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.
note: The queen of Sheba came skeptical and left saying the reports were too small; Jesus cites her in Matthew 12.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in _____ of me.
verse: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
note: The Lord's Supper words, as Paul received and passed them on: 'this do in remembrance of me.'
